name: v2 basic
note: Field order is domain, actor_oid, tenant_id, credential_identifier, nonce, not_after_ms. Each field is length-prefixed LP(s)=byteLength(s)+':'+s. not_after_ms is its decimal string.

name: v2 delimiter-injection (a,bc)
note: DEFECT 4: paired with (ab,c). A naive ':'-join would make actor='a',tenant='bc' collide with actor='ab',tenant='c'. Length-prefixing keeps them distinct.

name: v2 delimiter-injection (ab,c)
note: DEFECT 4: MUST differ byte-for-byte from (a,bc) above.

name: v2 colon-in-cred
note: DEFECT 4: a ':' inside credential_identifier is just value bytes (already counted); it cannot forge a field boundary. Paired with colon-in-tenant.

name: v2 colon-in-tenant
note: DEFECT 4: MUST differ byte-for-byte from colon-in-cred above.

name: v2 unicode field
note: Length prefix is measured in UTF-8 BYTES, not code points: 'oid:actor:é' is 11 code points but 12 bytes, so the prefix is 12.
